verdict.rationale: Whether a derivative ecosystem exists (community replicas, fine-tunes or quantizations on public hubs, with clear official-vs-unofficial attribution) is a fair question for any LLM product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of public-hub derivatives or attribution guidance. OpenAI's own hosted supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning is a related but different first-party feature, not a public derivative ecosystem, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a real derivative ecosystem exists around the model — community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations on public hubs — with clear attribution of what is and is not official
